name: two-people-chat
description: Alice signs in with a password account, reads the chat from her own Bee node and pays with her own drive. Bob signs in with an account secured with a wallet made for the run and lets the gateway pay. Each must see the other's message with the Swarm ID badge and the right stamp mark, and its details must say who paid. Alice then buys a second drive and changes the viewer's stamp to it in Swarm ID, sends on it, and Bob signs out. The chat feed must hold every message, each paid where it says.
steps: alice send "alice on her own stamp {run}" --stamp mine
expect sees alice "bob through the gateway {run}"
expect sees bob "alice on her own stamp {run}"
expect sender bob "alice on her own stamp {run}" name=chosen:alice badge=swarm-id stamp=own
expect sender alice "bob through the gateway {run}" name=chosen:bob badge=swarm-id stamp=gateway
expect details bob "alice on her own stamp {run}" identity=swarm-id sent=own own-feed=1 chat-feed=1 in-own-feed=yes
expect details alice "bob through the gateway {run}" identity=swarm-id sent=gateway ens=none
alice send "alice on her second drive {run}" --stamp mine
expect sees bob "alice on her second drive {run}"
